Part of [D: Dermatologicals](../).

**A bounded score needs a bounded likelihood.**
PASI has been fitted with a bounded integer model, to respect the discrete and bounded nature of the data [@ooiBoundedIntegerModelbased2023], and with a zero-inflated beta distribution, for the bounded nature and distributional characteristics of the score [@tsamandourasEmployingZeroinflatedBeta2024].
In one psoriasis analysis, fitting the 6-point physician's global assessment alone carried a substantial structural bias that joint modeling with PASI removed [@huImprovingCategoricalEndpoint2022].
